key_idea: After sorting, the longest common prefix of a string with any other string is attained at one of its two sorted neighbours, so the needed prefix length is 1 + max of the two adjacent LCPs.
sketch: Sort the aliases, compute the LCP of each adjacent pair by direct comparison, and add max(lcp_left, lcp_right)+1 for every alias (aliases are distinct and of equal length, so this never exceeds l). O(n l log n) for sorting, with n*l = 1e7 characters. A trie counting pass-through counts is an equivalent alternative. Use a 64-bit total out of habit, although the sum is at most 1e7.
